verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation and company-setup service, and a built-in AI assistant in its dashboard is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence covers incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filings, banking, SAFEs and documents, but never mentions an in-product AI assistant you can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt and .md doc probes make the docs readable by external LLMs; they are not a built-in assistant.
